list: Official PS5 trophy list, 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them; PSN progress counters as PSNProfiles lists them. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours — there is no separate task for it. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 at about 200 hours, in a single playthrough with no online trophies and no DLC required. The long pole is A Long Road (100% completion): finish the story, the stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles, and this pops with it. Nothing in the list needs a second playthrough, so one careful run, kept clean of cheats, is enough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — it unlocks when the mission ends, and the story cannot be skipped past it.
trophies.guide: Play the first main mission of Chapter 1, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the opening mission, so this is one of the first trophies most players earn — PSNProfiles already shows it as the commonest trophy on the list. Nothing to prepare; just finish the mission and the trophy pops when it completes.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — finishing the chapter is mandatory.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes the trophy pops once the first mission of Chapter 2 is done, so do not be surprised if it lands just after the chapter turns. Before the chapter ends, do the one thing in it that never comes back: meditate at Lucia's balcony spot, which counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears after Chapter 1. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter in case you miss it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — finishing the chapter is mandatory.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. PowerPyx notes it pops as Chapter 3 opens, with the mission Welcome to Vice City. This is also the chapter where both protagonists become playable together, after the mission Coffee Break — that opens most of the activity trophies, so use the chapter to try activities (Master of None) rather than rushing the story. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — finishing the chapter is mandatory.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. By now the stranger strands and side activities are open across Leonida — clear a few between story missions so the later cleanup stages are shorter. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — finishing the chapter is mandatory.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale. PowerPyx notes it pops after the final mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero. Before you start the final mission, make a manual save: the finale is the last point where a missed one-off can still be recovered cheaply, and the game has no mission replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — finishing the final mission is mandatory.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. It is the only gold trophy on the story path and the gate to free roam after the credits, where the cleanup stages (collectibles, activities, 100%) are done. Save before the mission — not because the trophy can be missed, but because a pre-finale save is the cheapest recovery point for anything else you skipped.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run, in Chapter 2, to the end. It is a named story mission rather than a chapter milestone, so it pops mid-chapter when the mission completes. No preparation and no alternate route — just finish it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist, in Chapter 3, to the end. Heist missions in this game are multi-part, so expect setup steps before the heist itself; the trophy pops when the heist mission completes, not when the setup starts.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play, in Chapter 4, to the end. Like the other named story missions, it pops on completion with nothing extra to do. If you are tracking the story trophies in order, this is one of the six named-mission trophies between the chapter milestones.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Headliners, in Chapter 4, to the end. The trophy name is the mission's own wordplay — it pops when the mission completes. No side objective is named in the official description, so treat it as a straight story completion.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown, in Chapter 4, to the end — a mission set at Vice City International Airport. Do not confuse it with Catch Me If You Can, which is a separate free-roam stunt at the same airport: that one is an unscheduled departure in a stolen passenger plane, this one is the story mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Story progression — the mission must be completed to advance the story.
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory, in Chapter 5, to the end. It is the last of the six named-mission story trophies, so by the time it pops you are deep into the story — a good moment to check the Missables page, since the stranger strands and the Chapter 1 meditation are the things players most often leave too late.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: Nothing in the 100% list is permanently missable if you keep manual saves, but the Chapter 1 meditation and the stranger strands are the two that force a reload when skipped.
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion checklist: 35 tasks reported by Insider Gaming — story finished, 100 optional tasks and missions, all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 34 smash 'n' grabs, 50 stick-ups, all 8 bank vaults, fencing and laundering targets, 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 30 magazines/books/comics, meditation spots, 100 cocaine flamingos, 2 unique playlists, 70 styles, 30 unique races won, 10 race gold medals, 42 shooting range gold medals, 4 video games, 5 pool opponents, 2 mini golf locations, 90 basketball hoops, 42 drone time trials, 300 stunts, 70 challenges, 15 Bret's target decks, 200 vehicles scanned, 50 standard weapons and 100 animals. PowerPyx stresses the targets are forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion. You only need 200 of 277 base model vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, and any 70 of 80 challenges; the only tasks that need everything are Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests. The checklist itself unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress made during the story already counts. Track it on the 100% page of this guide. Note the targets are higher than the matching trophies (300 stunts for 100% against 250 for Cunning Stunts; 70 challenges against 50 for One Last Thing), so keep going after those trophies pop.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableNote: Stunts are repeatable anywhere in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game. PowerPyx breaks them into four kinds: 130 Stunt Jumps (jumping over ramps), 202 Under the Bridges (flying under bridges), 40 Knife Flights (flying between buildings) and 25 Base Jumps (parachute challenges) — mix them however you like, and Under the Bridges are the quickest to do. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts (press R3 on a category for the regional split), or on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, where each stunt is listed by its own name and stays marked once done. Performing a stunt once counts as completed; the challenges attached to map icons are not required. The 100% list wants 300, so keep counting past this trophy.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableNote: Activities stay available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — the PSN counter tracks 9, and PowerPyx names them: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Ranges, Pool, Basketball (scoring hoops), Playing a Video Game, Win a Car Race or Race Challenge or Top Fun Drone Race, and Perform a Stunt. View them under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities, where scrolling over each shows how many you have done; on the map, filter for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) to find them. You are introduced to most of them automatically from the main story, and the rest get marked when you unfog the map — one try each is enough, you do not need to win or finish any of them for this trophy.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableNote: The range stays open in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 range locations — the PSN counter is 0/42. The range is a repeatable activity, so practice the slow ones first and leave the timed precision rounds for last. Gold needs the top score band on every challenge, not just a pass, so expect several attempts on the hardest ones. The 100% list also wants these 42 golds, so this trophy and that checklist row are the same work.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableNote: Drone races are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 drone races in total, and the PSN counter is 0/14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you must win at every one, not just win 14 races. Learn each course's line before racing it for the win, and note the 100% list also wants 42 drone time trials, which are a separate count from these race wins.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableNote: Races are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. PowerPyx counts 40 unique race locations across Leonida, so there is plenty of choice: vary the vehicle class and the event type as you go, and use the easier events first to bank the count. The 100% list wants 30 unique races won and 10 race challenge gold medals, so keep racing past this trophy: every unique win counts toward both.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Not confirmed missable — but Cal's fishing challenge is a one-off encounter, and the game has no mission replay. Take the challenge the first time it is offered and keep a manual save from before it.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Some time after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal sends a text that marks a fishing location with a purple icon on the map — follow his fishing questline from there. The challenge is the point, not casual fishing: it only counts if you win the head-to-head against Cal. Do it the first time it is offered, since no public source confirms the challenge can be replayed.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableNote: Arcade games stay playable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — play any of the 4 Video Games through to its end. PowerPyx names them: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all playable at the TV in your home by interacting with the controllers (from Chapter 1, though briefly unavailable during some story sections), and Bang For Your Buck, found at arcade machines throughout the world. To complete a game you must finish all its levels at least once — you do not need to beat all its challenges. Pick the shortest game first to bank the trophy early. The 100% list wants 4 video games played, so play a different cabinet for each of the four rather than replaying the same one.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: PowerPyx confirms Andy's strand stays available after the story, so this cannot be missed — finish it whenever you like.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. The strand is exclusive to Lucia: it gets marked automatically in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and then texts her home address in Belville. Complete her five quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van) and Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse). PowerPyx confirms all her quests are still available after the story, so there is no rush — the trophy pops when Andy's last mission completes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: PowerPyx confirms Kenton's strand stays available after the story, so this cannot be missed — finish it whenever you like.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. The strand gets marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), he calls, then the green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He offers treasure diving quests — shipwrecks marked with purple treasure chest icons on the map; find the underwater treasures and bring them back, using the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared, turning in sets as you go. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, and under Progress, then Collections, then Kenton's Treasures. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1, then available again in Chapters 2 to 3 — as Jason he texts you, and calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up. The trophy pops when Kenton's last mission completes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: PowerPyx confirms Billy's strand stays available after the story, so this cannot be missed — finish it whenever you like.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. The strand gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests: Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (Join Billy on a Job), Mall Rats (Join Billy on a Job), The Impaler (Steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes (Join Billy on a Job). PowerPyx confirms all his quests are still available after the story. The trophy pops when Billy's last mission completes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: PowerPyx confirms open-world Strangers & Freaks are still there after the story, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida — the PSN counter is 0/8. Only certain questlines count: PowerPyx confirms the five named stranger finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) do NOT count toward this trophy, and neither do Moses, Yasmani or Eddie. The strands confirmed to count are Kirk (Skunk Ape and Mr. Mangrove: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch, The Last Mile: Backseat Pilot, Pete's Deliveries and Deliver Packages). PowerPyx notes more strangers are yet to be discovered, so if the counter stalls short of 8, look for new stranger icons rather than replaying the named finals. Track the count in the trophy list, and remember the strands are still there after the story.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: PowerPyx confirms Randy's strand can still be done after the story, so this cannot be missed — finish it whenever you like.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. The strand gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), during which you unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. Randy then gives you a wish list of 16 sports cars to deliver: the Zorrusso is delivered automatically in the story mission, then the Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros, Pegassi Tempesta, Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, Buckingham Jubilee, Grotti Itali RSX, Pfister Growler, Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire, Piccia Furia, Benefactor Dubsta, Bravado Gauntlet, Banshee and Gallivanter Baller ST-D. Track them under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. He marks some cars for you in fixed locations, but you can also steal them off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on the list, then drive it back to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Deliver in good condition and he pays more. The cars turn up often in east Vice City, around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or driving around. This can still be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: PowerPyx confirms Tyrone's strand stays available after the story, so this cannot be missed — finish it whenever you like.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. The strand gets marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple map markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go there and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs), which unlocks the trophy. PowerPyx confirms all of this is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Possibly missable — the only trophy PowerPyx flags. The first meditation is offered at Jason's house in Chapter 1 (after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks to the balcony; follow her and choose Accept). It is gone after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway, and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, in 10 locations — the PSN counter is 0/18. Meditating with Lucia and Jason at the same spot counts as +2, so bring your partner to every spot. Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The one that catches players out is the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks out to the balcony — follow her, talk to her and choose Accept, and she shows you how to meditate. That meditation adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and PowerPyx says it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway, because it is gone once Chapter 1 ends. You cannot do the final meditation until you can play both characters together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Note the 100% list counts only 15 meditation spots while the trophy tracks 18 — do all 18 and both are covered.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Hunting stays available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a specific target animal, not just any hunt. Bret Vogel's questline gets marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County. It is exclusive to Jason — Lucia cannot receive the message. After that quest he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to Bret as Jason. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. Killing an animal with one clean shot leaves it pristine and pays more, but it is not mandatory. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck: there are 15 Target Decks in total, and all 15 are needed for the 100% list, so this trophy comes naturally along the way. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableNote: Cards stay collectible in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. PowerPyx counts 18 card set locations across Leonida, so the three sets for this trophy are the start of a much longer hunt — the 100% list wants 15 sets in total. Collect as you travel rather than in one sweep: grab cards whenever you pass a known spot, and use the 100% page to track the running total.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableNote: WAiNK spots stay available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — WAiNK scans are objects in the world you scan by holding Up and then R1. There are more than 100, so it does not matter which ones you scan: PowerPyx counts 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher Tags. The 100% list also wants 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and that checklist row finish together. Hit a few WAiNK spots on every trip instead of saving all 100 for the endgame.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableNote: Challenges stay available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and you only need 50 for this trophy — and 70 for the 100% list, so keep going past this one. View and track them under Progress, then Challenges: the Completed checkmark in the bottom right, when scrolling over a challenge, shows which are done. A lot of them complete naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% requirements, so leave this for one of your last trophies and pick the easiest and quickest challenges you have remaining.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Wanted levels are repeatable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it and escape. The earliest you can do this is after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together as Jason and Lucia — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Getting to 4 stars is easy: cause carnage until you reach it. The best way to escape is a fast sports motorcycle, cutting through traffic to get out of the search area; if a helicopter is chasing you, shoot at it until it goes away. The easiest method PowerPyx names is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia, in Kelly County: the cops have trouble following you on the train tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy unlocks after you drive out of the red heat wanted zone — not after you leave the immediate blue and red flashing search area. You will also get it automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): the large bank vault robberies there always trigger 4-star wanted levels, and they are mandatory for the 100% list.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Shop robberies are repeatable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level between them. You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons on the map) while being chased the whole time, and keep the red and blue flashing wanted level — not the red heat level. Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs (bought at Ammu-Nations) and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle, then loot 3 shops in a row. The unlock is delayed: it pops about half a minute after leaving the 3rd shop. A good place to do it is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each store and ideally go into the back room and break the safe with sticky bombs. If you leave the first store before the police arrive, you may need to hit a 4th shop — keep going until it pops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableNote: Vehicles stay discoverable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes), and the easiest way to discover 100 quickly is the WAiNK app on your phone: hold Up to use it instantly without selecting it from the phone, then look at vehicles and hold R1 to scan them. Just stand at a busy road and scan all the vehicles passing by — scanning a vehicle is enough, you do not need to drive it. You need to scan 200 of the base model vehicles for the 100% list, so this trophy comes automatically on the way. Check your discovered vehicles under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles: scrolling over each category shows the totals found.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableNote: Combat Focus can be used in any fight, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: it slows time and highlights vulnerable spots on enemies, and drains the purple focus bar in the top left of the screen, below health and stamina. You have to kill or incapacitate 5 enemies in one use, but Combat Focus only lasts a few seconds — so first buff your focus by eating or drinking, or washing your face or showering at home, and consume Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, then press Triangle). Then line up 5 enemies, for example the criminals at a Gang Operation, and defeat them quickly without missing a shot. Wear body armor (bought at Ammu-Nations) so you can walk out of cover and get close, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 — more accurate than pistols and SMGs, and full-auto. The trophy does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. This gets easier as you level up your focus: there are 4 levels, checked under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Focus (the purple eye icon), and you raise Focus by playing Shooting Range challenges, Golf, Pool, catching fish and landing headshots at psychopath criminal profile. While working on all the other trophies you will automatically reach Focus Level 4, and there is a good chance you earn this naturally along the way.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Repeatable in free roam — steal a plane docked at a VCIA terminal whenever you like, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — Vice City International Airport: steal one of the large passenger planes docked to a departure terminal and fly it away. It does not work with the passenger planes on the airfield; it has to be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge. Inside the plane go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly far enough away from the airport until the trophy unlocks — you must fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away, and the unlock is a bit delayed. The easiest plane is the one connected to departure terminals E3 and E4: drive through one of the fences around the airfield and head straight to it; next to the boarding bridge are stairs with a door leading directly into the plane. You can also enter the plane on foot through the airport terminal, where it is docked to E3/E4 — going over the airfield is faster. This is a free-roam stunt at the airport, not the story mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: Combat encounters are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and use it in combat. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County, standing in the south of the air base. Drive in through the gate, or take the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, then enter a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks. GTABase reports the same method, and PowerPyx shows it in video: the trigger is taking a Rhino out and fighting in it, not a specific kill count.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: Jewelry store robberies are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, not a smash-and-grab. First, finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and unlocks Jewelry Store Robberies, marked automatically in unfogged map areas with a green icon. Break into a store through the backdoor using the Snap Gun — it stays in your inventory permanently and you do not need to equip it; when you approach a locked door you get the prompt to kick the door (which triggers the alarm) or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach. Enter the backroom, look for a note with the safe code, and use the code to loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. If you are spotted, leave and try another store: the trophy only counts a clean run. The 100% list wants $100,000 of fenced jewelry, so a clean jewelry run also feeds that total.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableNote: Bank vaults are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one — the PSN counter is 0/5. First, finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): it is the introduction to bank vault robberies, and you do the first one automatically as part of the mission. You tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then a guard carries a briefcase with cash into the bank and they open the vault — quickly go in while the vault is open and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash yourself, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off one bag. After this quest you can pay Yasmani (the fence unlocked in Chapter 3) for tips about security vans: if you have not done his previous quests yet, do those first (robbing 2 Payday Loans), then he sells tips for $10,000, which marks the security vans with a purple icon — follow them to the bank. Robbing a bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level: use a fast motorcycle to cut through traffic, then switch to another vehicle to become unrecognizable. There are 8 Large Bank Jobs in total; you only need any 5 for this trophy, but all 8 for the 100% list, so you will earn this automatically. It is also the best way to make money in the endgame — up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableNote: Armored trucks run repeatable routes, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is automatic: finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), the same mission that unlocks bank vault robberies. Robbing the vault of a large bank automatically counts as robbing an armored truck — you tail the armored truck to the bank, the guard carries the cash to the vault, you quickly enter the vault to steal all the cash and escape the red heat radius, or use a Pay 'n' Spray. You have to rob all 8 Large Bank Jobs for the 100% list anyway, so you will get this automatically. There is also a method to get it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after doing his quests; Yasmani is unlocked as a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableNote: Exploration is repeatable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — the PSN counter tracks 52 areas. You need to fully unfog the whole map, and the fastest way is by plane: fly over all the areas that are still black fog on the map until the entire map is visible. This finishes naturally while you chase the collectibles (cards, WAiNK spots, meditation spots), so do not grind it alone — explore on the way to everything else and the counter fills itself.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableNote: Illegal operations are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — the PSN counter is 0/9. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total; you only need to complete 1 operation belonging to each gang for this trophy, but all 39 for the 100% list, so you will unlock this automatically. Operations get marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress, then Gangs: scroll over a gang and the bottom right shows how many of their operations you have robbed.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: No part of the description points to a one-off event, so this is treated as repeatable until a source says otherwise.
trophies.guide: The trigger for this trophy is still unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, and no public guide has pinned it down yet. The official description is the only hint — a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — so the shape of it is clear (a drink at a beachfront spot with a view), but the exact bar or the exact action is not. Do not chase a guess from an unverified list; this guide will be updated when a source confirms the trigger. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: Showrooms are repeatable targets, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Steal a specific car from a specific showroom and drive it through the showroom's window. The car you need is the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy): hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the window. The unlock is slightly delayed — it pops after you drive further away on the street. The trophy only unlocks from this blue Banshee specifically, not from any other car: it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III. GTABase reports the same method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableNote: The bowling alley robbery is repeatable — if you miss a valuable, the robbery icon respawns and you can go back for it, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the Gang Operations in Port Gellhorn. Before going there, buy Sticky Bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to destroy the safe. The robbery gets marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside, pick up the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the office in the south-east (it has a golden icon), the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner (golden icon), and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway — blow it up with Sticky Bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not immediately when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. If you do not rob all 3 items during the optional mission, wait until the robbery icon respawns (it takes a long time), then go back and steal the remaining valuables — so the trophy is not missable, and you do not need all 3 in one go.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: No part of the description points to a one-off event, so this is treated as repeatable until a source says otherwise.
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check your Strength level under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia (select a character), then scroll down to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Increase Strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club, and always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner). While you actively work out with one character, the other automatically completes their training, so you make double the progress. Filter for fitness clubs on Map, then Activities (the dumbbell icon); there are lots of them all over Vice City. You can also work out at home after the story. GTABase reports the same method.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Choices accumulate across the playthrough, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — the PSN counter is 0/500, and you can view how many you have done by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. PowerPyx recommends turning on Criminal Profile notifications in the UI settings (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On): whenever you do something that affects your reputation, you will see a little demon face on the right side of the screen. The profiles run from Professional (finishing objectives and robberies stealthily, destroying evidence, clean escapes) through Hardened (incapacitating enemies without killing them, shooting them in the limbs), Violent (killing enemies and civilians) and Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, or driving over gravestones) to Irredeemable — a permanent status if you keep using excessive violence. There is a good chance you get this naturally while working on all the other trophies and the 100% list, so do not worry about it; every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If you still do not have it when you are done with everything else, farm it quickly by running over civilians and cops with a car — but note that cops are more likely to shoot at you on sight when you are at psycho or irredeemable profile.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: No part of the description points to a one-off event, so this is treated as repeatable until a source says otherwise.
trophies.guide: The trigger for this trophy is still unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The official description — second time's the charm — points to succeeding at something on the second attempt, but no public guide has pinned the exact trigger down yet. If an activity beats you, try it again immediately rather than moving on; this guide will be updated when a source confirms the trigger. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: No part of the description points to a one-off event, so this is treated as repeatable until a source says otherwise.
trophies.guide: The trigger for this trophy is still unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline, and GTABase points to a strange event somewhere in Leonida — neither is confirmed. The official description — what the hell just happened? — points to stumbling on something strange, the game's oddity or easter-egg moment. Explore the strange places (the swamps, the keys, the odd landmarks, and the Kelly County area the UFO lead points to) and it will find you; this guide will be updated when a source confirms the trigger. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableNote: Drive-bys are repeatable, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: The trigger for this trophy is still unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The official description — bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — points to knocking enemies over from a moving vehicle with a melee attack, the way a bowling ball bowls pins over. Try it on a motorcycle, swinging a melee weapon at enemies as you ride past; this guide will be updated when a source confirms the trigger. Source for the name, description and grade: the official list on Exophase.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableNote: Laundering stays available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — the PSN counter is 0/250000. First, finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew): it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob Banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a Fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. You need to deliver $250,000 in total, counted across all robberies; you do not need to bring $250,000 at once. It comes naturally while you do all the robberies for the 100% list, and bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery within a few minutes — though those only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableNote: Shops stay open in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — the PSN counter is 0/100000, and it counts spending everywhere, not in one shop. Buying guns, car mods and tattoos is the fastest method, as these are the most expensive. PowerPyx counts the shops in the game: 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations (gun stores), 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear Stores, 18 Hair and Beauty Salons, 11 Tattoo Studios and 15 Electronics Stores. Buy what you actually want and the total climbs on its own; by the endgame most players are close.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableNote: Properties stay buyable in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties — the PSN counter is 0/8. There are 8 purchasable garages and 4 story-related garages; for this trophy you only need the 8 purchasable ones, which cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that a new app has been installed on your phone, called Vice City Real Estate, and you simply buy the garages through the phone app. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially later in Chapters 3 and 4 when you unlock higher-value robberies.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableNote: Vehicle registration stays available in free roam, so this cannot be missed.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the PSN counter is 0/10. The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses): it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location wherever you are. To register 10 vehicles you must buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds 1 or more parking spots for more vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage click Respray and Register. You unlock Moses from the same mission that unlocks the app. Initially he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers, at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so to keep expenses low go for cheap low-end cars and bikes. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good (discover 100 vehicles): register the interesting ones as you discover them and both counters climb together.
